lines.image: The second line’s perseverance is good because it remains balanced.

lines.text: The petty person uses force; the superior person uses restraint. Perseverance brings danger. A ram butts the hedge and snags its horns.
lines.image: The petty person relies on force, while the superior person does not.

lines.text: Perseverance brings good fortune, and regret disappears. The hedge opens, and the ram is no longer trapped. Strength lies in the hub of the great carriage.
lines.image: The hedge opens and the ram is freed because it continues forward.

lines.text: The sheep is lost at the boundary. There is no regret.
lines.image: Losing the sheep at the boundary is due to occupying an unsuitable position.

lines.text: The ram butts the hedge. It can neither retreat nor advance, and nothing is beneficial. Difficulty brings good fortune.
lines.image: Being unable to retreat or advance is ominous. Facing difficulty brings good fortune, and blame will not last.

core: Great strength is available, but power must be directed by righteousness rather than impulse. Restraint preserves its force and prevents aggression from becoming self-destructive.
plain: You have considerable strength and influence, but that does not justify overreach. Act from a clear sense of what is right, keep your temper under control, and avoid turning force into unnecessary confrontation.
advice: Act firmly, but do not let strength become aggression.

name: 火地晉
judgment: Progress. The marquis is honored with a gift of horses and abundant livestock; he is received three times in a single day.
tuan: Progress means advancing. Light rises above the earth, and in orderly fashion joins with the great brightness. The yielding line advances upward, and therefore the marquis is honored with a gift of horses and abundant livestock and is received three times in a single day.
xiang: Light rises above the earth: this is Progress. The superior person makes his own virtue manifest and clear.

lines.text: Advancing, then pressed back; perseverance brings good fortune. Without trust, be generous, and there will be no blame.
lines.image: Advancing even when pressed back shows independent right conduct. Being generous without blame means you have not yet been entrusted with a mandate.

lines.text: Advancing, then anxious; perseverance brings good fortune. Receive this great blessing from the king’s mother.
lines.image: Receiving this great blessing comes from maintaining balance and right conduct.

lines.text: The multitude agrees. Regret disappears.
lines.image: The multitude’s agreement supports the intention to advance upward.

lines.text: Advancing like the greedy rat. Perseverance brings danger.
lines.image: The greedy rat’s perseverance is dangerous because its position is unsuitable.

lines.text: Regret disappears. Do not worry about loss or gain; going forward is favorable, and nothing is unfavorable.
lines.image: Not worrying about loss or gain means going forward brings celebration.

lines.text: Progress reaches only the horns. It is fit for attacking a town. Danger brings good fortune and no blame, but perseverance brings disgrace.
lines.image: Attacking a town is appropriate because the way has not yet become fully illuminated.

core: Progress succeeds when advancement follows the natural order and rests on clear virtue. Recognition and material support come to those who advance steadily without forcing the situation.
plain: This is a favorable time for advancement, promotion, and the visible expression of your abilities. Make your merit clear through honest conduct, remain patient with gradual recognition, and avoid assuming you have already been honored.
advice: Show your merit clearly and advance one measured step at a time.

name: 地火明夷
judgment: Darkening of the Light. Perseverance through difficulty is beneficial.
tuan: Light enters the earth, and thus there is the Darkening of the Light. Inner clarity combined with outward gentleness enables one to endure a great hardship, as King Wen did. Perseverance through difficulty is beneficial because it conceals the light within. One who faces inner hardship and can straighten the intention acts as Jizi did.
xiang: Light enters the earth: this is the Darkening of the Light. The superior person governs the people by concealing brilliance while maintaining clear judgment.

lines.text: When the light is darkened, the bird lowers its wings. The superior person leaves and goes without food for three days. If he proceeds, the host speaks harshly.
lines.image: The superior person leaves without food because right conduct takes priority over sustenance.

lines.text: The light is darkened, and the bird wounds its left thigh. A strong horse comes to the rescue. Good fortune.
lines.image: The second line’s good fortune comes from complying with what is proper.

lines.text: In the darkened light, the bird hunts in the south and catches its chief. It must not act too quickly. Perseverance is needed.
lines.image: The intention to hunt in the south brings a great prize.

lines.text: It enters the left side of the body and finds the darkened heart. It leaves the courtyard.
lines.image: Entering the body and finding the heart’s intention reveals the hidden purpose.

lines.text: Jizi’s light is darkened. Perseverance is beneficial.
lines.image: Jizi’s perseverance shows that true clarity cannot be extinguished.

lines.text: Without clarity, all is dark. At first it rises to heaven; afterward it enters the earth.
lines.image: Rising to heaven illuminates the four quarters; afterward entering the earth loses the proper way.

core: A clear intelligence may be hidden while outward circumstances become dark and hostile. Keep your principles intact, act with prudence, and avoid forcing recognition or exposing yourself to danger.
plain: Your insight may be correct, but the situation does not reward candor or direct challenge. Preserve your inner clarity, behave gently in public, and use careful judgment until conditions allow your virtue to emerge safely.
advice: Keep your insight private and endure difficulty without compromising your principles.

name: 風火家人
judgment: Family: beneficial for the woman to remain steadfast.
tuan: In the Family, the woman occupies her proper place within, and the man occupies his proper place without. When man and woman each fulfill their proper roles, they embody the great meaning of heaven and earth. A family has a strict ruler: this means the parents. When the father acts as a father, the son acts as a son, the elder brother acts as an elder brother, the younger brother acts as a younger brother, the husband acts as a husband, and the wife acts as a wife, the way of the family is rectified. When the family is rectified, the world is set in order.
xiang: Wind rises from fire; this is the Family. Thus the superior person gives substance to his words and maintains consistency in his conduct.

lines.text: Guard the family from the beginning, and regrets disappear.
lines.image: Guarding the family at the beginning means the intention has not yet changed.

lines.text: Do not act on your own initiative; stay in charge of preparing the household food. Remaining steadfast brings good fortune.
lines.image: The good fortune of the second line comes from following with humility.

lines.text: A harsh household provokes regret and danger, yet remains auspicious; wife and children joking without restraint will end in disgrace.
lines.image: The strictness of the household has not yet become excessive. The laughter of wife and children has broken the restraint proper to the family.

lines.text: A wealthy household brings great good fortune.
lines.image: The wealth of the household and its great good fortune arise from following while occupying the proper position.

lines.text: The king comes to the household; do not worry, for it is auspicious.
lines.image: The king comes to the household because father and son love one another.

lines.text: Maintain sincerity and an authoritative bearing; this will ultimately bring good fortune.
lines.image: The good fortune of an authoritative bearing comes from turning inward and examining oneself.

core: A well-ordered family is built on trust, proper roles, and steady conduct. Firm but consistent guidance allows everyone to thrive without dividing the household’s purpose.
plain: This situation concerns the responsibilities and conduct of a household. Set clear expectations, respect each person’s proper role, and deal firmly but consistently with problems. The household becomes stable when its rules are fair and consistently upheld.
advice: Set clear household rules and enforce them consistently without harshness.

name: 火澤睽
judgment: Opposition: small matters are auspicious.
tuan: In Opposition, fire moves upward while the marsh moves downward. Two women live together, but their intentions do not move together. Joyous and attached to clarity, the yielding line advances upward and, in the middle, responds to the firm. Therefore, small matters are auspicious. Heaven and earth are opposed, yet their affairs are united. Man and woman are opposed, yet their intentions communicate. All things are opposed, yet their affairs belong to the same categories. The timeliness of Opposition is indeed great.
xiang: Fire is above and the marsh below: this is Opposition. Thus the superior person seeks common ground while recognizing differences.

lines.text: Regrets disappear. Do not chase the lost horse; it will return on its own. Meet the evil person without blame.
lines.image: Meeting the evil person is a way to avoid blame.

lines.text: Meet your ruler in the alley without blame.
lines.image: Meeting the ruler in the alley means the proper way has not yet been lost.

lines.text: You see the carriage dragged backward, its ox restrained, and its driver faced with heaven and mutilation. There is no beginning, but there will be an end.
lines.image: The carriage is dragged backward because the position is unsuitable. Though there is no beginning, there will be an end because it encounters the firm.

lines.text: Opposed and alone, you meet a noble first man. Mutual trust brings danger but no blame.
lines.image: Mutual trust is free of blame because the intention can be carried into action.

lines.text: Regrets disappear. Your kin bites through the sacrificial meat. Why would going there bring blame?
lines.image: Your kin bites through the sacrificial meat, so going there brings celebration.

lines.text: Opposed and alone, you see a pig covered with mud and a cart full of ghosts. First you draw your bow, then you loosen it. They are not bandits but partners seeking marriage. Going to meet them is auspicious as rain.
lines.image: The auspiciousness of meeting them in rain lies in the disappearance of all doubts.

core: Different people may move in opposing directions while still sharing a larger purpose. Small matters succeed when the parties remain cooperative and recognize what unites them.
plain: People or interests appear to conflict, but the difference need not prevent limited progress. Keep goals modest, communicate directly, and look for shared interests rather than insisting on identical views.
advice: Focus on shared goals and handle each disagreement with a small, practical step.

name: 水山蹇
judgment: Obstruction: beneficial to go southwest, not northeast. Beneficial to see the great person. Remaining steadfast is auspicious.
tuan: Obstruction means difficulty: danger stands ahead. To see danger and be able to stop is wisdom. In Obstruction, going southwest is beneficial because it leads to the middle. Going northeast is not beneficial because that path ends in exhaustion. It is beneficial to see the great person because going forward brings achievement. Occupying the proper position with steadfastness is auspicious and brings order to the state. The timeliness of Obstruction is indeed great.
xiang: Water is on the mountain: this is Obstruction. Thus the superior person turns inward and cultivates his virtue.

lines.text: Going forward is obstructed; returning brings praise.
lines.image: Going forward is obstructed, while returning brings praise; it is best to wait.

lines.text: The king’s servant is beset by difficulties, but not because of himself.
lines.image: Though the king’s servant is beset by difficulties, he will ultimately incur no blame.

lines.text: Going forward is obstructed; returning reverses the situation.
lines.image: Going forward is obstructed, while returning brings inner joy.

lines.text: Going forward is obstructed; returning brings connection.
lines.image: Going forward is obstructed, while returning brings connection because the position is proper and its substance is firm.

lines.text: In great obstruction, a friend comes.
lines.image: In great obstruction, a friend comes because the conduct remains balanced.

lines.text: Going forward is obstructed; returning brings abundant good fortune. It is beneficial to see the great person.
lines.image: Going forward is obstructed, while returning brings abundance because the intention remains inwardly directed. It is beneficial to see the great person because one follows what is noble.

core: Difficulty lies ahead, and forcing progress can deepen the problem. Wisdom lies in recognizing the obstacle, choosing the viable route, and strengthening yourself while waiting for appropriate help.
plain: You face a difficult route and cannot simply force your way through. Identify what lies ahead, turn inward to correct your own weaknesses, and seek help from someone wise and influential. Move only when a sound path opens.
advice: Stop before danger, correct your weaknesses, and seek wise assistance.

name: 雷水解
judgment: Deliverance: beneficial to go southwest. If there is nowhere to go, returning is auspicious. If there is somewhere to go, going early is auspicious.
tuan: Deliverance means acting amid danger in a way that escapes it. Moving southwest is beneficial because it brings the support of the people. Returning is auspicious because it reaches the middle. If there is somewhere to go, going early is auspicious because going forward brings achievement. When heaven and earth are released, thunder and rain arise; when thunder and rain arise, all fruits and plants break open. The timeliness of Deliverance is indeed great.
xiang: Thunder and rain arise: this is Deliverance. Thus the superior person pardons errors and grants leniency to offenders.

lines.text: There is no blame.
lines.image: At the meeting point of the firm and the yielding, the conduct is free from blame.

lines.text: Hunting in the fields, you catch three foxes and obtain the yellow arrow. Remaining steadfast is auspicious.
lines.image: The steadfast good fortune of the second line comes from following the middle way.

lines.text: You carry a burden and ride in a carriage, inviting robbers to come. Remaining steadfast brings disgrace.
lines.image: Carrying a burden and riding in a carriage is also shameful. If one brings warfare upon oneself, who else can be blamed?

lines.text: The foot is released, and friends arrive, bringing trust.
lines.image: Releasing the foot is not yet in the proper position.

lines.text: The superior person has relief; this is auspicious, and small people retreat.
lines.image: The superior person achieves relief, and small people withdraw.

lines.text: The ruler shoots the falcon upon the high wall, capturing it. Nothing is unfavorable.
lines.image: The ruler shoots the falcon to resolve rebellion.

core: A period of tension is ending, and relief can be gained by releasing what has become burdensome. Timely action brings achievement, while patience and clemency help restore order.
plain: The pressure is beginning to ease. If you have a clear direction, act promptly; if not, return to a stable position rather than forcing movement. Let go of lingering resentment and handle mistakes with generosity so the situation can truly clear.
advice: Act promptly on a clear goal, and release old resentment without delay.

name: 山澤損
judgment: Diminishing: sincerity brings great good fortune and no blame. It is right to persevere. It is beneficial to have somewhere to go. What will suffice for the offering? Two bowls of food will suffice.
tuan: When diminishing, one reduces what is below and increases what is above, so the way proceeds upward. Diminishing with sincerity brings great good fortune and no blame. It is right to persevere. It is beneficial to have somewhere to go. What will suffice for the offering? Two bowls of food will suffice. Two bowls must be offered at the proper time; the strong must be diminished and the weak increased at the proper time. As loss and gain, fullness and emptiness move together with the times.
xiang: A mountain has a marsh below it: this is Diminishing. Thus the superior person restrains resentment and blocks desire.

lines.text: After the work is done, hurry to leave without blame. Consider reducing it further.
lines.image: After the work is done, hurry away; this still accords with shared purpose.

lines.text: It is beneficial to persevere, but moving forward brings misfortune. If you do not diminish, you increase instead.
lines.image: The second nine benefits from perseverance because it makes moderation its purpose.

lines.text: When three walk together, one must be removed; when one walks alone, one finds a companion.
lines.image: One walking alone may become suspicious when there are three.

lines.text: Diminish your troubles, and swiftly bring yourself good fortune without blame.
lines.image: Putting troubles aside is itself cause for joy.

lines.text: Perhaps someone will increase the value of your turtle oracle by ten pairs of shells. You cannot oppose it. Great good fortune.
lines.image: Great good fortune for the fifth line comes from support from above.

lines.text: Do not diminish; instead increase. There is no blame, and perseverance brings good fortune. It is beneficial to have somewhere to go. You will win loyal ministers without regard to family.
lines.image: By adding rather than diminishing, one greatly fulfills one’s ambition.

core: Reduce what is excessive and support what is lacking, adjusting gains and losses to the needs of the moment. Difficulty comes first, but ease follows if you spend within your means.
plain: Some sacrifice is required before benefit becomes possible. Reduce excess rather than everything at once, increase what is insufficient, and wait for the right moment to offer or act. Steady sincerity and disciplined use of resources make the reduction productive rather than impoverishing.
advice: Cut one genuine excess and redirect it to what most needs support.

name: 風雷益
summary: Reducing the Top to Benefit the Bottom
judgment: Increase: it is beneficial to have somewhere to go, and beneficial to cross the great river.
tuan: In Increase, one reduces what is above and increases what is below, so the people’s joy knows no bounds. Giving from above to those below makes the way shine brightly. It is beneficial to have somewhere to go, because balance and rightness bring celebration. It is beneficial to cross the great river, for the way of the wood then moves. Increase stirs and enters, advancing day by day without bound. Heaven gives and earth produces; their increase has no fixed shape. Every principle of increase moves with the times.
xiang: Wind and thunder: this is Increase. Thus the superior person follows goodness when he sees it and corrects himself when he has faults.

lines.text: It is beneficial to undertake great work. Great good fortune and no blame.
lines.image: Great good fortune and no blame arise because those below are not burdened with excessive obligations.

lines.text: Perhaps someone will increase the value of your turtle oracle by ten pairs of shells; you cannot oppose it. Persevere forever for good fortune. The king offers sacrifice to the Supreme Deity, and it is auspicious.
lines.image: The increase comes from outside, from an unexpected source.

lines.text: Using increase in a time of misfortune brings no blame. Sincerity and the middle way: announce the matter to the ruler and offer him a jade tablet.
lines.image: Using increase during misfortune is appropriate when one already possesses what is needed.

lines.text: Follow the middle way, announce the matter to the ruler, and gain his following. It is beneficial to rely on him and move the capital.
lines.image: Announcing the matter to the ruler and gaining his following serves the purpose of increasing.

lines.text: Sincerity and a benevolent heart: there is no need to ask. Great good fortune. Sincerity favors me with its virtue.
lines.image: A sincere benevolent heart leaves no need for further questioning. Favor received through sincerity greatly fulfills one’s ambition.

lines.text: No one increases him; instead, someone attacks him. If the heart does not remain constant, there is misfortune.
lines.image: That no one increases him is an impartial judgment. The attack comes from outside.

core: Reduce excess at the top and increase support below, creating room for worthwhile action. Progress depends on generosity, balanced movement, and the courage to undertake great work.
plain: Benefits become real when they are shared and used to advance worthy projects. Contribute from where you have abundance, support those below, and move forward without waiting for perfect conditions. Sound judgment and steady initiative turn this increase into lasting progress.
advice: Use your advantage now to support a worthy undertaking and others.

name: 澤天夬
judgment: Breakthrough: declare it in the royal court. Your sincere call carries danger. Announce it from your city; it is unbeneficial to meet the enemy in arms, but beneficial to have somewhere to go.
tuan: Breakthrough means resolving. The strong resolves the weak. It is vigorous and joyful: decisive, yet harmonious. To declare it in the royal court means that the weak rides upon the five strong lines. A sincere call carries danger, for danger reveals its brightness. To announce it from your city is unbeneficial when immediately taking up arms, because what is honored will reach its end. It is beneficial to have somewhere to go, for only as the strong increase will the process reach completion.
xiang: A marsh lies above heaven: this is Breakthrough. Thus the superior person bestows benefits on those below and avoids claiming the merit of his own virtue.

lines.text: You become overstrong in the toes of your front foot; if you go forward, you cannot prevail and will be distressed.
lines.image: Pressing forward despite the inability to prevail is the cause of blame.

lines.text: Be watchful and cry out. Even at night, there may be an enemy, but do not worry.
lines.image: Even if an enemy appears, there is no need for worry because the way remains balanced.

lines.text: You become overstrong in your cheek, and there is danger. The superior person resolves decisively and walks alone. If he meets rain, he may be soaked and anger others, yet there is no blame.
lines.image: The superior person decides firmly and ultimately incurs no blame.

lines.text: Your buttocks have no flesh, so your movement is halting. If you lead the way like a sheep, regret disappears. Yet when you hear the warning, you do not believe it.
lines.image: Your hesitant movement comes from an unsuitable position. Refusing to believe the warning comes from failed judgment.

lines.text: Break through the succulent weed and act decisively. Following the middle way brings no blame.
lines.image: Following the middle way brings no blame, though the middle has not yet fully shone forth.

lines.text: There is no call to sound; in the end, there will be misfortune.
lines.image: The misfortune of an unanswered call cannot endure forever.

core: A clear decision is needed to remove what obstructs the greater good. Act firmly, but distinguish correction from warfare and preserve harmony while the balance of forces shifts.
plain: Some situation has reached the point where it must be confronted openly. Announce the truth, resist the temptation to use force immediately, and proceed toward a positive goal. Decisive action is safe when it follows the proper middle course rather than aggression.
advice: Make the necessary decision openly, but do not confuse it with war.

name: 天風姤
judgment: Coming to Meet: the woman becomes strong. Do not take her as your wife.
tuan: Coming to Meet means meeting. The weak meets the strong. Do not take her as your wife, for you cannot join with the strong for long. Heaven and earth meet, and all things take on distinction and form. When the strong encounters the central and right, the great way prevails throughout the world. The timeliness and meaning of Coming to Meet is exceedingly great.
xiang: Wind moves beneath heaven: this is Coming to Meet. Thus the ruler issues commands and makes proclamations in all four directions.

lines.text: Bind yourself to the metal brake. Perseverance brings good fortune. If you go forward, you will see misfortune, as a lean pig hesitates and struggles.
lines.image: Binding yourself to the metal brake shows that the weak way is being restrained.

lines.text: There is fish in the bundle. There is no blame, but it is unbeneficial to invite a guest.
lines.image: The fish is present, but the proper meaning does not extend to welcoming a guest.

lines.text: Your buttocks have no flesh, so your movement is halting and dangerous, though there is no great blame.
lines.image: Your halting movement occurs because you have not yet been restrained.

lines.text: There is no fish in the bundle; if you rise, misfortune follows.
lines.image: The misfortune of finding no fish comes from losing contact with those farther away.

lines.text: With a branch of the quince tree, wrap the melon. Hold within yourself your excellence. Something may fall from heaven.
lines.image: The fifth nine holds his excellence through balance and rightness. What falls from heaven does not depart from his purpose or destiny.

lines.text: The meeting occurs at the horns. There is distress, but no blame.
lines.image: Meeting at the horns shows that the top has reached the limit of its narrow path.

core: Unexpected strength approaches, bringing both opportunity and danger. Do not mistake attraction or immediate benefit for a durable alliance; assess the new force before joining with it.
plain: Something previously weak is gaining strength and entering the situation unexpectedly. It may offer opportunity, but it can also become dangerous if allowed to grow unchecked. Establish sound constraints early and avoid commitments based only on attraction or promise.
advice: Assess the new force carefully and set limits before committing.

name: 地澤萃
judgment: Gathering Together: Success. The king approaches the ancestral temple. It is beneficial to see the great man. Success and constancy. The sacrifice of a great ox brings good fortune, and it is beneficial to have somewhere to go.
tuan: Gathering means assembling. Through obedience and joy, with firmness at the center responding to the outer elements, people gather. The king approaches the ancestral temple to make reverent offerings. It is beneficial to see the great man: gathering succeeds when it is upright. The sacrifice of a great ox brings good fortune, and it is beneficial to have somewhere to go, for this follows Heaven’s mandate. Observe where people gather, and the true feelings of heaven, earth, and all things become visible.
xiang: Water gathers on the earth: this is Gathering Together. The superior person removes weapons and guards against unforeseen trouble.

lines.text: Truthfulness does not endure; confusion and gathering follow. If you cry out, laughter follows in a single grasp. Do not worry; going forward brings no blame.
lines.image: The confusion and gathering arise because the intention has become disordered.

lines.text: Drawing near brings good fortune and no blame. Sincerity makes even a simple sacrifice beneficial.
lines.image: Drawing near brings good fortune and no blame because the central intention remains unchanged.

lines.text: Gathering together, but with sighing; nothing is beneficial. Going forward brings no blame, only a minor vexation.
lines.image: Going forward brings no blame because the upper trigram is gentle and yielding.

lines.text: Great good fortune and no blame.
lines.image: Great good fortune and no blame arise because the position is not appropriate.

lines.text: Gathering in the proper position brings no blame. If trust is lacking, perseverance must be complete and lasting; regret disappears.
lines.image: Gathering in the proper position shows that the intention has not yet become fully radiant.

lines.text: Sighing, spitting, and weeping bring no blame.
lines.image: Sighing, spitting, and weeping show that the upper position is not yet secure.

core: Abundant resources and people come together in a way that supports success when the gathering is led with sincerity and right order. The right connections can open new opportunities.
plain: This situation calls for bringing people and resources together, seeking out wise leadership, and acting with proper principles. Prepare carefully for the unexpected, but do not let fear prevent constructive cooperation.
advice: Organize people around shared goals and prepare for unforeseen risks.

name: 地風升
judgment: Pushing Upward: Great success. It is beneficial to see the great man; do not worry. A southern campaign brings good fortune.
tuan: Softness rises in accordance with the proper time. Being yielding yet obedient, with firmness at the center responding to the outer elements, this produces great success. It is beneficial to see the great man and not to worry, for there will be celebration. A southern campaign brings good fortune because the intention is carried into action.
xiang: Wood grows from beneath the earth: this is Pushing Upward. The superior person follows what is proper, accumulating small things until they become tall and great.

lines.text: Genuine ascent brings great good fortune.
lines.image: Genuine ascent brings great good fortune because it aligns with the higher purpose.

lines.text: Sincerity makes even a simple sacrifice beneficial, with no blame.
lines.image: The sincerity of the second yang line brings joy.

lines.text: Ascending as though through an empty city.
lines.image: Ascending through an empty city means there is no reason for doubt.

lines.text: The king offers sacrifice at Mount Qi. Good fortune and no blame.
lines.image: The king offers sacrifice at Mount Qi because he acts in accordance with the proper course.

lines.text: Constancy brings good fortune: ascend the steps.
lines.image: Constancy brings good fortune and ascending the steps fully accomplishes the intention.

lines.text: Blind ascent benefits only unceasing constancy.
lines.image: Blind ascent at the top brings depletion rather than abundance.

core: Progress comes through gradual, well-timed advancement supported by humility, patience, and sound guidance. The farther one rises, the more important it becomes not to force the next step.
plain: Move forward steadily, using the right time and trusted guidance rather than dramatic leaps. Small gains create the height you seek, and a clear purpose turns effort into meaningful advancement.
advice: Advance one sound step at a time and keep building.

name: 澤水困
judgment: Oppression: Success and constancy. The great man brings good fortune and no blame. Words are spoken, but they are not believed.
tuan: Oppression means that the rigid has covered the yielding. In danger yet joyful, one remains true to one’s place even under pressure and therefore succeeds. This applies especially to the superior person. Constancy, and good fortune for the great man, arise from firmness at the center. Words are spoken but not believed because relying on speech leads to exhaustion.
xiang: The lake has no water: this is Oppression. The superior person speaks the word that reaches the farthest and pursues the fulfillment of the intention.

lines.text: The buttocks are trapped by stumps and brushwood; entering a dark valley, one does not see daylight for three years.
lines.image: Entering the dark valley means the darkness within has not been illuminated.

lines.text: Trapped amid wine and food, while the vermilion robe approaches. It is beneficial to make sacrifices. A campaign is bad, though there is no blame.
lines.image: Though trapped amid wine and food, there is celebration within.

lines.text: Pressed against stone and resting on thorns, one enters the home but does not see the wife: bad fortune.
lines.image: Resting on thorns means riding over the rigid. Entering the home without seeing the wife is an ill omen.

lines.text: One comes slowly, trapped by a metal carriage. There is vexation, but there is an end.
lines.image: Coming slowly shows that the intention remains directed downward. Although the position is unsuitable, there is still assistance.

lines.text: Nose and feet are cut off, and the great man is trapped despite the vermilion robe. Joy comes slowly; it is beneficial to make sacrifices.
lines.image: Nose and feet being cut off show that the intention has not been fulfilled. Joy comes slowly because the center is straight. Sacrificial offerings bring blessings.

lines.text: Trapped by vines and thorny creepers, one says, “Regret comes from movement.” If regret comes, a campaign is favorable.
lines.image: Being trapped by vines and creepers shows that the position is not suitable. Movement that brings regret and overcomes it makes action favorable.

core: Severe pressure may silence outward expression, but it does not have to destroy purpose or integrity. Success depends on remaining true to what matters and acting without empty argument.
plain: You may face constrained circumstances in which explanation and persuasion do little. Keep your principles, use what resources you have, and focus on actions that can produce a real result rather than defending yourself endlessly.
advice: End futile argument and act on what remains possible.

name: 水風井
summary: A shared resource sustains the community
judgment: The Well: The settlement changes, but the well does not. Neither lost nor gained. People come and go at the well. The water is nearly reached but does not flow into the well; the rope breaks and the jar falls: bad fortune.
tuan: Water is drawn upward through the yielding wood: this is The Well. A well provides nourishment without end. The settlement changes while the well remains unchanged, because firmness at the center holds its course. The water is nearly reached but does not flow into the well, so no achievement results. The broken rope and fallen jar make the situation disastrous.
xiang: Water rises above wood: this is The Well. The superior person encourages the people and urges them to assist one another.

lines.text: The well is muddy and cannot be used. The old well has no birds.
lines.image: The muddy well cannot serve those below. The old well is left unused because the time has passed.

lines.text: A fish leaps into the well’s ravine, but the broken jar leaks.
lines.image: A fish in the well’s ravine has no one to benefit it.

lines.text: The well is cleansed but no one drinks from it. My heartache is for this. It can be drawn from, and the king’s wisdom allows all to share its blessings.
lines.image: The cleansed but unused well causes heartache. Seeking the king’s wisdom brings the shared blessings.

lines.text: The well’s brickwork is repaired, bringing no blame.
lines.image: Repairing the well’s brickwork brings no blame because the well has been restored.

lines.text: The well yields clear, cold water, fit to drink.
lines.image: The clear, cold water is upright and pure.

lines.text: The well is drawn from and left uncovered. Sincerity brings great good fortune.
lines.image: Great good fortune at the top completes the work.

core: A shared resource remains valuable even as circumstances and settlements change. Progress depends on maintaining its flow and ensuring that people can draw from and sustain it.
plain: The source still exists, but it may be neglected, blocked, or mishandled. Review the shared system, repair what has deteriorated, and make sure people can benefit from it without wasting its value.
advice: Maintain the shared source and repair what blocks its flow.

name: 澤火革
summary: Change aligned with heaven and humanity
judgment: Revolution: On the day in question, sincerity will be established. It is fundamentally good and prosperous. Perseverance in what is right. Regret disappears.
tuan: Revolution. Water and fire extinguish each other. Two young women live together, but their aims do not agree; this is called revolution. On the day in question, sincerity will be established, and the new order will be trusted. With enlightenment and joy, it brings great success through correctness. If revolution is properly timed, regret will disappear. Heaven and earth undergo change, and the four seasons are thereby completed. Tang and Wu carried out revolution, in accordance with heaven and responsive to humanity. How great and timely is the meaning of revolution!
xiang: Fire in the marsh: this is revolution. The superior person uses revolution to regulate the calendar and clarify the seasons.

lines.text: Secure the hide of a yellow ox.
lines.image: To secure the hide of a yellow ox means that nothing can yet be accomplished.

lines.text: On the day in question, make the change. It is good to move forward, with no blame.
lines.image: To make the change on the proper day brings favorable results in action.

lines.text: Moving forward brings disaster. Perseverance is dangerous. A proposal for revolution must be considered three times before it can be trusted.
lines.image: Why keep changing the proposal again and again? It must first be considered carefully.

lines.text: Regret disappears. Sincerity is established. Change the mandate, and it is good.
lines.image: The good fortune of changing the mandate comes from trusting and pursuing one's purpose.

lines.text: The great person changes like a tiger. Before any effort to determine it, there is already trust.
lines.image: The great person's transformation shines with the brilliance of a tiger's markings.

lines.text: The superior person changes like a leopard. The lesser person changes only his outward appearance. Moving forward brings disaster, but remaining still is good.
lines.image: The superior person's transformation has the richness of a leopard's markings. The lesser person merely changes his outward appearance and, in yielding, follows the superior person.

core: A situation requires substantial change, but the change must follow the proper order and win genuine acceptance. Remain true to what is right while transforming what has become outdated.
plain: The existing order no longer works and must be changed. Act at the proper time, make the new arrangement credible, and ensure that it serves people rather than merely serving your own interests.
advice: Make the necessary change now, but earn trust before enforcing it.

name: 火風鼎
judgment: The Cauldron: Great good fortune and prosperity.
tuan: The Cauldron is an image. Wood feeds fire beneath it; this signifies the transformation of raw food. The sage uses the cauldron to offer sacrifice to the supreme deity and, through great abundance, to nourish the worthy. With yielding conduct and clear hearing and sight, the weak advances and moves upward. It attains the middle and responds to the strong; this is the source of its fundamental prosperity.
xiang: Fire above wood: this is the Cauldron. The superior person establishes his proper position and makes his mandate firm.

lines.text: The cauldron is turned upside down, making it easy to remove the waste. One obtains a concubine with her son, and there is no blame.
lines.image: Turning the cauldron upside down does not violate its nature. Removing the waste is beneficial because it allows one to follow what is worthy.

lines.text: The cauldron contains food. My opponent has illness and cannot approach me; this is good.
lines.image: The cauldron contains food, so one should be careful where one goes. Although my opponent has illness, he will ultimately have no blame.

lines.text: The cauldron's handles are altered, preventing it from being carried, so the fat pheasant cannot be eaten. When the rain finally comes, regret is reduced, and the outcome is ultimately good.
lines.image: Altering the cauldron's handles has departed from what is proper.

lines.text: The cauldron's legs break, and the ruler's food is overturned and spilled. The shame is great, and the outcome is disastrous.
lines.image: How can the ruler's food be trusted when it has been overturned and spilled?

lines.text: The cauldron has yellow handles and metal carrying bars. It is beneficial to persevere in what is right.
lines.image: The yellow handles of the cauldron signify inner solidity and a proper center.

lines.text: The cauldron has jade carrying bars. Great good fortune, with nothing unfavorable.
lines.image: The jade carrying bars above signify the proper balance of strength and yielding.

core: Success requires a strong vessel capable of transforming raw materials and sustaining worthy people. Prepare carefully, maintain sound judgment, and ensure that what you build can fulfill its purpose.
plain: You have a chance to create something stable and valuable, but its quality depends on proper preparation and the right people. Keep a sound structure, handle resources carefully, and do not take on more than you can support.
advice: Build the right structure, then use it to sustain others.

name: 震為雷
judgment: Shock: It is prosperous. Shock arrives with fear and trembling; afterward, one can laugh and speak without difficulty. A shock that reaches a hundred miles does not make one lose the spoon and the vessel of sacrificial wine.
tuan: Shock is prosperous. When shock arrives with fear and trembling, fear can lead to good fortune. Afterward, laughing and speaking without difficulty shows that there are principles for conduct. A shock reaching a hundred miles alarms those far away and puts fear into those nearby. One can go out to guard the ancestral temple and the state, serving as the master of sacrifice.
xiang: Thunder follows thunder: this is Shock. The superior person uses fear to discipline himself.

lines.text: Shock arrives with fear and trembling; afterward, one can laugh and speak without difficulty. It is good.
lines.image: When shock arrives with fear and trembling, fear can lead to good fortune. Afterward, laughing and speaking without difficulty shows that there are principles for conduct.

lines.text: Shock arrives harshly. One loses vast amounts of wealth and rises to high ground. Do not pursue it; it will be found in seven days.
lines.image: The harshness of the shock comes from riding over the strong.

lines.text: One is shaken and unsettled. In the midst of shock, one moves forward without blame.
lines.image: One remains unsettled because his position is not appropriate.

lines.text: Shock extends into the mud.
lines.image: Shock extending into the mud shows that clarity has not yet been achieved.

lines.text: Shock comes and goes harshly. One loses nothing and has matters to handle.
lines.image: Shock coming and going harshly makes movement dangerous. The matter is balanced at the center, so nothing substantial is lost.

lines.text: One trembles and searches in fear, staring ahead in alarm. Moving forward brings disaster. If the shock does not touch oneself but only the neighbor, there is no blame. Marriage and family life bring criticism.
lines.image: The trembling has not yet found its center. Though the situation is dangerous, there is no blame if one is mindful of the neighbor and takes precautions. The criticism concerns marriage and family life.

core: A sudden shock tests your stability, but it need not destroy your composure. Let fear alert you to danger, then regain control and act according to clear principles.
plain: An unexpected event can shake everyone, but panic does not have to decide the outcome. Stay alert, preserve your basic responsibilities, and recover your ability to speak and act calmly.
advice: Absorb the shock, keep your duties, and wait for clarity.

name: 艮為山
summary: Act or rest at the proper moment
judgment: Keeping Still: Keep still at the back, and the body is not reached. Walk through the courtyard, but the person is not seen. There is no blame.
tuan: Keeping Still means stopping. Stop when it is time to stop, and move when it is time to move. If movement and stillness do not miss their proper moments, the way becomes clear. Keep still at the place where one should stop. Those above and below oppose and correspond to one another without joining together; this is why the body is not reached. Walking through the courtyard without seeing the person brings no blame.
xiang: Mountains stand together: this is Keeping Still. The superior person considers things without stepping beyond his position.

lines.text: Keep still at the toes, with no blame. It is beneficial to persevere in what is right for long.
lines.image: Keeping still at the toes means not yet departing from what is correct.

lines.text: Keep still at the calves. One cannot rescue what follows, and the heart is dissatisfied.
lines.image: One cannot rescue what follows because one has not yet withdrawn to listen.

lines.text: Keep still at the waist. The back's sinews are torn apart, and the danger burns the heart.
lines.image: Keeping still at the waist creates danger that burns the heart.

lines.text: Keep still in the body, with no blame.
lines.image: Keeping still in the body means stopping through personal discipline.

lines.text: Keep still at the mouth, and speech has order. Regret disappears.
lines.image: Keeping still at the mouth through balanced and correct speech.

lines.text: Generous stillness is good.
lines.image: The good fortune of generous stillness comes from a stable and generous ending.

core: There are times to act and times to stop, and wisdom lies in recognizing which is which. Rest at the proper limit without becoming rigid, and do not intrude beyond your role.
plain: You may need to pause, but only until the right moment arrives. Use this period to understand your position and prepare; do not force movement or abandon a responsibility that still belongs to you.
advice: Stop where you should, and move only when the time is right.

name: 風山漸
judgment: Development: A woman’s marriage is auspicious; it is favorable to remain steadfast.
tuan: Development means gradual progress. A woman’s marriage is auspicious because she advances into the proper place and her journey will succeed. By advancing according to what is right, she can bring order to the state. Her place is strong and central. When she stops, she yields; when she moves, she does not exhaust herself.
xiang: Trees grow upon the mountain: this is Development. Thus the noble person settles into worthy virtue and improves the customs of the people.

lines.text: The wild goose develops upon the shore. The young one is in danger and receives criticism, but has no blame.
lines.image: The young one’s danger is justified, so it is blameless.

lines.text: The wild goose develops upon the rock. It eats and drinks with ease and abundance. Auspicious.
lines.image: It eats and drinks with ease; it does not merely survive on plain fare.

lines.text: The wild goose develops upon the high ground. If the husband goes forth, he will not return; the wife is pregnant but will not give birth. Inauspicious. It is favorable to defend against attackers.
lines.image: The husband who goes forth will not return because he leaves the flock and its companions. The wife’s pregnancy does not come to birth because she has departed from the proper way. To defend against attackers is favorable, for preserving one another accords with righteousness.

lines.text: The wild goose develops upon the tree. It may find a level branch to perch on. No blame.
lines.image: It may find a level branch because it moves in a gentle, yielding manner.

lines.text: The wild goose develops upon the high mound. The wife remains childless for three years, but in the end no one can overcome her. Auspicious.
lines.image: In the end no one can overcome her; this is auspicious because she attains what she wishes.

lines.text: The wild goose develops upon the broad path. Its feathers can serve as ceremonial ornament. Auspicious.
lines.image: Its feathers can serve as ceremonial ornament; this is auspicious because they must not be put to disorderly use.

core: Progress that follows the right sequence accumulates little by little, while impatience destroys the result. Steady movement suited to the situation is beneficial.
plain: This situation calls for development in stages rather than dramatic leaps. Build your position carefully, wait for the proper conditions, and do not force what is not yet ready. Steady and correct advancement will bring worthwhile results.
advice: Advance one sound step at a time without rushing.

name: 雷澤歸妹
summary: A Marriage That Violates Proper Order
judgment: The Marrying Maiden: It is inauspicious to go forth, and there is nothing beneficial.
tuan: The Marrying Maiden embodies the great meaning of heaven and earth. If heaven and earth do not mingle, all things fail to flourish. The marrying maiden is the completion of the human cycle of beginning and end. Joyfulness prompts movement, and this is why the younger sister is the one who goes. It is inauspicious to go forth because her place is inappropriate. Nothing is beneficial because the weak rides upon the strong.
xiang: Thunder over the marsh: this is The Marrying Maiden. Thus the noble person looks to the enduring end and understands the failures that may arise.

lines.text: The younger sister marries. Though lame, she can walk. It is auspicious to go forth.
lines.image: The younger sister marries as the second daughter because this is constant. Though lame, she can walk; her auspiciousness lies in properly joining with another.

lines.text: Though only partially sighted, she can see. It is favorable for the secluded person to remain steadfast.
lines.image: It is favorable for the secluded person to remain steadfast because this does not depart from constancy.

lines.text: The younger sister marries, but waits. In the end, she returns to marry the second daughter.
lines.image: The younger sister waits to marry because she has not yet attained the proper place.

lines.text: The younger sister’s marriage is delayed past the appointed time, but there is a proper time for her delayed return.
lines.image: Her intention to delay reflects the need to wait for the proper time before acting.

lines.text: King Yi gives his daughter in marriage. His ruler’s robe is not as fine as that of her attendant sister, though the moon approaches full. Auspicious.
lines.image: Although King Yi gives his daughter in marriage, her robe is not finer than that of her attendant sister. Her place is central, and she acts with dignity.

lines.text: The woman receives an empty basket, and the man slits a ram but there is no blood. There is nothing beneficial.
lines.image: The woman at the top receives an empty basket, leaving only an appearance of substance.

core: A union founded contrary to proper order approaches its limits. Clear insight into the situation requires ending unrealistic hopes and acting with restraint.
plain: This situation resembles a marriage entered in the wrong order: the initial appeal may be attractive, but the arrangement cannot support sustained progress. Examine the long-term consequences rather than merely the immediate gain. Do not proceed until the roles and expectations are soundly established.
advice: Clarify the proper order before making any commitment.

name: 火雷豐
judgment: Abundance: Success. The king approaches it; do not worry. It is appropriate to be like the sun at noon.
tuan: Abundance means greatness. Clarity joined with movement produces abundance. The king approaches it because he esteems greatness. Do not worry: it is appropriate to be like the sun at noon, illuminating the whole world. At noon the sun begins to decline, and when the moon is full it begins to be eaten. Heaven and earth wax and wane according to the movement of time; how much more so should human beings? How much more so should spirits be?
xiang: Thunder and lightning arrive together: this is Abundance. Thus the noble person resolves lawsuits and carries out punishments decisively.

lines.text: The ruler encounters his equal. Though they are matched throughout the cycle, there is no blame; going forth receives honor.
lines.image: Though they are matched throughout the cycle, they have no blame; passing beyond that cycle would bring disaster.

lines.text: The covering is abundant, but at noon the stars of the Dipper can be seen. Going forth brings suspicion and sickness, but sincerity initiates action. Auspicious.
lines.image: Sincerity initiates action, giving confidence to express one’s resolve.

lines.text: The canopy is abundant, but at noon the dimness can be seen. His right arm is broken, and there is no blame.
lines.image: When the canopy is abundant, no great undertaking can be accomplished. With the right arm broken, he cannot ultimately be used.

lines.text: The covering is abundant, but at noon the stars of the Dipper can be seen. He encounters his equal, and it is auspicious to act.
lines.image: The abundant covering is inappropriate to his place. Seeing the Dipper at noon means the light is hidden and unclear. Meeting his equal makes it auspicious to act.

lines.text: Brilliant achievements come, bringing celebration and praise. Auspicious.
lines.image: The auspiciousness of the sixth and fifth lines brings celebration.

lines.text: The house is grand, and the family is wealthy. He peers through the door and sees no one inside. For three years he sees no one, and the situation is inauspicious.
lines.image: The grand house rises to the sky’s edge. Peering through the door and seeing no one means he has hidden himself away.

core: Prosperity is powerful and can fulfill plans, bringing celebration, but it inevitably turns toward decline. Judgment must therefore be clear, fair, and firm.
plain: This is a time of maximum strength and visibility, when significant plans can succeed and bring rewards. Yet the height of abundance is already close to decline, so do not become complacent. Use the momentum to settle matters clearly, administer justice fairly, and prepare for what comes next.
advice: Use this peak of strength to act clearly and prepare for decline.

name: 火山旅
summary: Adapt While Moving Through the World
judgment: The Wanderer: There is modest success. For the traveler, remaining steadfast is auspicious.
tuan: The Wanderer has modest success. The weak line holds the central place outside and accords with the strong. It stops and attaches itself to clarity, and therefore there is modest success. For the traveler, remaining steadfast is auspicious. The meaning of the traveler’s proper timing is immense.
xiang: Fire upon the mountain: this is The Wanderer. Thus the noble person uses clear and careful judgment in administering punishment and does not prolong cases.

lines.text: The traveler worries over trifles and thus invites disaster upon himself.
lines.image: The traveler’s anxious concern over trifles narrows his purpose and brings disaster.

lines.text: The traveler reaches his lodging and carries his wealth with him. He gains a young servant and remains steadfast.
lines.image: By gaining a young servant and remaining steadfast, he ultimately avoids blame.

lines.text: The traveler burns down his lodging and loses his young servant. Remaining steadfast here is dangerous.
lines.image: The traveler burns down his lodging, and harm comes with it. Treating those below him as outsiders causes the sense of community to disappear.

lines.text: The traveler finds lodging and obtains his money and axe, yet his heart is not satisfied.
lines.image: The traveler has lodging but has not attained a proper place. Even with money and an axe, his heart is not satisfied.

lines.text: The traveler shoots a pheasant and loses one arrow, but in the end he gains praise and an appointment.
lines.image: In the end he gains praise and an appointment because the superior authority recognizes him.

lines.text: The bird burns its nest. The traveler first laughs, then weeps. He loses his ox at the market. Inauspicious.
lines.image: A traveler who occupies the highest place is bound, by the meaning of the situation, to burn his dwelling. Losing the ox at the market goes unnoticed to the end.

core: In a temporary and unstable situation, modest aims may succeed while grand ambitions remain out of reach. Adapt to changing conditions, remain prudent, and avoid needless conflict.
plain: You are in a transitional position without a secure base, so keep expectations realistic and make modest but meaningful progress. Seek temporary shelter, reliable assistance, and clear information while moving carefully. Avoid turning a passing stay into a confrontation or an extravagant plan.
advice: Keep plans modest, gather reliable support, and move carefully.

name: 巽為風
summary: Subtle influence and persistent, adaptable penetration into circumstances
judgment: The Gentle: Small success. It is favorable to have a destination to go, and favorable to see a great person.
tuan: Doubled wind reiterates commands. The firm yields to the balanced and upright, and its will is carried out. The yielding lines all comply with the firm; therefore there is small success, it is favorable to have a destination to go, and it is favorable to see a great person.
xiang: Winds following one after another: this is the image of the Gentle. The noble person clarifies commands and carries out affairs accordingly.

lines.text: Advancing and retreating; it is favorable to maintain the steadfastness of a warrior.
lines.image: Advancing and retreating means the will is wavering. The steadfastness of a warrior is favorable because the will becomes disciplined.

lines.text: Yielding beneath the bed; using scribes and diviners in profusion brings good fortune and no blame.
lines.image: The good fortune of using them in profusion comes from finding the central balance.

lines.text: Repeatedly yielding brings regret.
lines.image: The regret of repeatedly yielding comes from exhausting one's determination.

lines.text: Regret vanishes; the hunt yields three kinds of game.
lines.image: Catching three kinds of game in the hunt marks real achievement.

lines.text: Steadfastness brings good fortune; regret vanishes, and nothing is unfavorable. No beginning, but an end. Three days before the change and three days after the change bring good fortune.
lines.image: The good fortune of the fifth nine is due to its central and upright position.

lines.text: Yielding beneath the bed, losing one's traveling axe; steadfastness brings misfortune.
lines.image: Yielding beneath the bed marks reaching the extreme at the top. Losing one's traveling axe means misfortune is certain.

core: The Gentle represents steady, pervasive penetration, moving like the wind into every open space. Progress is achieved through patient adaptability, aligned purpose, and unyielding inner resolve.
plain: Direct force will not succeed right now; introduce your ideas gradually and repeatedly instead. Communicate your intentions with absolute clarity and stay adaptable to changing conditions. Choose your moments of decisive action deliberately and keep trusted guides in sight.
advice: Advance through gentle, consistent persuasion rather than confrontation, and hold your ground firmly.

name: 兌為澤
summary: Genuine shared joy through open exchange and inner firmness
judgment: The Joyous: Success. It is favorable to be steadfast.
tuan: The Joyous means gladness. Firm within and yielding without, it brings joy rooted in steadfast correctness, thereby according with heaven and answering people. Leading the people with joy, they forget their toil; confronting danger with joy, they forget their fear of death. Great indeed is the power of joy that moves the people forward!
xiang: Joined lakes: this is the image of the Joyous. The noble person joins with friends for discussion and practice.

lines.text: Harmonious joy brings good fortune.
lines.image: The good fortune of harmonious joy comes from acting without doubt.

lines.text: Sincere joy brings good fortune; regret vanishes.
lines.image: The good fortune of sincere joy comes from trusting one's own will.

lines.text: Craving joy brings misfortune.
lines.image: The misfortune of craving joy occurs because one's position is improper.

lines.text: Deliberating without peace; staying clear of affliction brings cause for celebration.
lines.image: The joy of the fourth nine is a cause for celebration.

lines.text: Placing trust in what erodes brings danger.
lines.image: Trusting what erodes brings danger, even though one holds the correct position.

lines.text: Seducing others into joy.
lines.image: Seducing others into joy is not an honorable path.

core: The Joyous depicts two interconnected lakes continually replenishing each other through mutual exchange. Real joy flourishes when external warmth and openness are anchored by solid internal principles.
plain: Cultivate an environment of goodwill, honest collaboration, and mutual encouragement. Remain open and receptive in dealing with others, but ensure your core values stay uncompromised. Beware of flattering others or seeking cheap validation that degrades your self-respect.
advice: Foster goodwill through open, honest conversation, but refuse compromise on core principles.

name: 風水渙
summary: Dissolving rigid barriers and rallying collective unity across divides
judgment: Dispersal: Success. The king approaches his ancestral temple. It is favorable to cross the great river, and favorable to be steadfast.
tuan: Dispersal brings success. The firm arrives without being exhausted; the yielding attains its proper place outside and aligns with what is above. The king approaches his ancestral temple because he stands centered. It is favorable to cross the great river because boarding wooden boats brings achievement.
xiang: Wind moving over water: this is the image of Dispersal. Ancient kings made offerings to the Supreme Lord and established temples accordingly.

lines.text: Bringing rescue with a strong horse brings good fortune.
lines.image: The good fortune of the initial six comes from compliance.

lines.text: In the dispersal, running to one's support; regret vanishes.
lines.image: Running to one's support in the dispersal fulfills one's desire.

lines.text: Dispersing one's self brings no regret.
lines.image: Dispersing one's self brings no regret because the will is set on what lies beyond.

lines.text: Dispersing one's faction brings supreme good fortune. Scattering into a great mound is something ordinary minds cannot conceive.
lines.image: Dispersing one's faction brings supreme good fortune because it is radiant and great.

lines.text: Dispersing sweat like a sweeping proclamation; the king dwells securely, and there is no blame.
lines.image: The king dwelling securely without blame comes from holding the upright seat.

lines.text: Dispersing bloodshed, departing far away; there is no blame.
lines.image: Dispersing bloodshed means staying far from harm.

core: Dispersal symbolizes wind sweeping over water, breaking up stagnation, mistrust, and hardened isolation. Cohesion is renewed when individuals look beyond narrow self-interest toward a shared, higher allegiance.
plain: Dismantle the emotional barriers, silos, and old grudges that keep your group divided. Bring everyone together around a shared mission that transcends petty factional conflicts. Once unity is restored, take on major initiatives and take calculated risks with confidence.
advice: Dissolve personal rivalries and unite everyone around a common, meaningful objective.

name: 水澤節
summary: Establishing clear boundaries, healthy discipline, and balanced moderation
judgment: Limitation: Success. Painful limitation cannot be maintained as steadfast.
tuan: Limitation brings success. Firm and yielding are distinguished, and the firm attains the center. Painful limitation cannot be maintained as steadfast because its way leads to a dead end. Proceeding through danger with gladness, regulating according to one's proper place, balance and uprightness open the way. Heaven and earth practice limitation, and the four seasons are completed. By regulating through measures and rules, resources are not wasted and the people are not harmed.
xiang: Water above a lake: this is the image of Limitation. The noble person establishes numbers and measures, and evaluates virtue and conduct.

lines.text: Not going out of the courtyard brings no blame.
lines.image: Not going out of the courtyard shows knowing when paths are open or blocked.

lines.text: Not going out of the gate courtyard brings misfortune.
lines.image: Not going out of the gate courtyard brings misfortune because one misses the critical moment.

lines.text: Showing no restraint leads to sighing; there is no one else to blame.
lines.image: The sighing of having no restraint: who else is there to blame?

lines.text: Contented limitation brings success.
lines.image: The success of contented limitation comes from upholding the path above.

lines.text: Sweet limitation brings good fortune; going forward earns esteem.
lines.image: The good fortune of sweet limitation comes from dwelling in the central position.

lines.text: Bitter limitation: steadfastness brings misfortune, yet regret vanishes.
lines.image: Bitter limitation brings misfortune if maintained, because its path has reached a dead end.

core: Limitation depicts water contained within the natural bounds of a lake, showing how structure gives definition and strength to life. Constraints must remain sensible and humane, for excessive austerity inevitably triggers rebellion or collapse.
plain: Define clear boundaries, budgets, and operational limits to protect your resources from waste. Adopt structure and discipline willingly rather than imposing punishing rules that crush morale. Pay close attention to timing, knowing when to stay put and when to move forward.
advice: Set clear, realistic boundaries and practice self-restraint without imposing oppressive rules.

name: 風澤中孚
judgment: Inner Truth: Pigs and fish are auspicious; it is favorable to cross the great river; it is favorable to persist.
tuan: Inner Truth: the yielding line is within, and the firm line occupies the central place. Rejoicing and humility together transform the nation. The auspiciousness of pigs and fish means that trust reaches even pigs and fish. It is favorable to cross the great river because one rides in an empty wooden boat. Inner Truth, with its favoring of perseverance, responds to Heaven.
xiang: Wind moves over the lake: this is Inner Truth. The noble person considers lawsuits and delays the death penalty.

lines.text: Guarding against danger is auspicious, but turning toward another course brings no peace.
lines.image: Guarding against danger is auspicious because the intention has not changed.

lines.text: The crying crane is in the shade, and its young responds to it. I have fine wine; I will share it with you.
lines.image: Its young responds because this comes from the heart's desire.

lines.text: Meeting an adversary, one may beat the drum or stop it, weep or sing.
lines.image: One may beat the drum or stop because the position is not fitting.

lines.text: As the moon nears full, the horse loses its mate; there is no blame.
lines.image: The horse loses its mate because it breaks off from its kind and rises above them.

lines.text: Trust holds firm and unbroken; there is no blame.
lines.image: Trust holds firmly because the position is proper.

lines.text: The cry of a wild goose rises to Heaven; perseverance brings misfortune.
lines.image: How can the cry of a wild goose rise to Heaven and endure?

core: Sincere trust that reaches even the humble can unite people and earn loyal support. When promises are backed by real integrity, difficult obstacles can be crossed.
plain: Even a small offering made with sincere intent is auspicious, and trust of this kind can open the way to major undertakings. Remain honest and consistent, especially when others depend on you.
advice: Keep your promises and show your sincerity through consistent, trustworthy conduct.

name: 雷山小過
judgment: Small Exceeding: Success; it is favorable to persist. Small matters may be undertaken, but not great matters. The call of a flying bird remains. It is not fitting to rise; it is fitting to descend. Great auspiciousness.
tuan: Small Exceeding: the lesser things exceed and bring success. Exceeding with the favoring of perseverance accords with the times. The yielding line holds the central place, and therefore small matters are auspicious. The firm line has lost its proper position and is not centered, and therefore great matters cannot be undertaken. There is the image of a flying bird, leaving its call behind. It is not fitting to rise; it is fitting to descend. Great auspiciousness, because rising goes against the order, while descending accords with it.
xiang: Thunder moves over the mountain: this is Small Exceeding. The noble person carries excess beyond reverence in conduct, beyond grief in mourning, and beyond frugality in spending.

lines.text: A flying bird brings misfortune.
lines.image: A flying bird brings misfortune; there is no way to prevent it.

lines.text: Passing his grandfather, he meets his grandmother. He does not reach his lord but meets his servant. There is no blame.
lines.image: He does not reach his lord because a servant must not be passed over.

lines.text: Do not pass beyond him; guard against it. If you follow, someone may harm you, and it is ominous.
lines.image: If you follow and someone harms you, how can misfortune not follow?

lines.text: There is no blame. Do not pass beyond; meet him. If you go forward into danger, be on your guard. Do not use eternal perseverance.
lines.image: Do not pass beyond; meet him, because the position is not fitting. If you go forward into danger, be on your guard; it cannot last.

lines.text: Dense clouds bring no rain, coming from the western outskirts. The lord shoots and takes the one in the hole.
lines.image: Dense clouds bring no rain because they have already risen.

lines.text: Do not meet him; pass beyond him. A flying bird leaves him, and it is ominous, called a calamity.
lines.image: Do not meet him; pass beyond him, because he has already gone too far.

core: The moment favors modest excess in small matters, not ambitious action in large ones. Humility, restraint, and careful timing prevent small oversights from becoming disasters.
plain: This is a time when small, careful adjustments can succeed, but grand moves cannot. Lower your position, avoid unnecessary prominence, and let restrained conduct create room for success.
advice: Restrain your ambitions and favor modest, careful action over grand gestures.

name: 水火既濟
summary: Success achieved, but guard against decline
judgment: After Completion: Success in small matters; it is favorable to persist. There is good fortune at the beginning, but disorder at the end.
tuan: After Completion brings success because the lesser matters succeed. It is favorable to persist because the firm and yielding lines are correctly placed. At the beginning there is good fortune because the yielding line holds the central place. When the end is reached, disorder begins because the way has reached its limit.
xiang: Water is above fire: this is After Completion. The noble person anticipates troubles and takes precautions against them.

lines.text: Dragging its wheel and wetting its tail, there is no blame.
lines.image: Dragging the wheel is right, and therefore there is no blame.

lines.text: The woman loses her veil; do not pursue it, for in seven days it will be found.
lines.image: It is found in seven days because the way is balanced.

lines.text: King Gao of Song attacked the Ghosts, and conquered them after three years. Do not employ petty people.
lines.image: It took three years to conquer them because the effort left them exhausted.

lines.text: There is clothing and fine cloth; be on guard throughout the day.
lines.image: Be on guard throughout the day because there is something to be doubted.

lines.text: The eastern neighbor kills an ox; this is not as good as the western neighbor's simple offering, which receives his full blessings.
lines.image: The eastern neighbor's ox-slaughter is not as good as the western neighbor's timely offering; receiving full blessings brings great good fortune.

lines.text: It wets its head; this is dangerous.
lines.image: Wetting its head is dangerous; how can it last?

core: A difficult undertaking has been completed successfully, but its very success can conceal the conditions for decline. Preserve what has been achieved through restraint, vigilance, and timely reform.
plain: The work is done and small matters succeed, yet lasting order still depends on perseverance. Do not relax after success; anticipate hidden problems before they turn into disorder.
advice: Maintain your standards and prepare for hidden risks before success turns to decline.

name: 火水未濟
summary: Unfinished work requires patience and persistence
judgment: Before Completion: Success. A small fox nearly crosses the river, wets its tail, and gains no advantage.
tuan: Before Completion brings success because the yielding line holds the central place. The small fox nearly crosses the river but has not yet left the middle. It wets its tail and gains no advantage because it cannot continue to the end. Although the lines are not in their proper positions, the firm and yielding lines correspond to one another.
xiang: Fire is above water: this is Before Completion. The noble person carefully distinguishes things and gives each its proper place.

lines.text: It wets its tail; there is embarrassment.
lines.image: It wets its tail because it does not know where the limit lies.

lines.text: Dragging its wheel, perseverance is auspicious.
lines.image: The second line is auspicious in perseverance because it moves correctly through the central position.

lines.text: The work is not complete; to advance is ominous, but it is favorable to cross the great river.
lines.image: Advancing while unfinished is ominous because the position is not fitting.

lines.text: Perseverance is auspicious and regret disappears. Move with thunderous force to attack the Ghosts. In three years, rewards will come from the great states.
lines.image: Perseverance brings auspiciousness and removes regret because the intention is put into action.

lines.text: Perseverance is auspicious and there is no regret. This is the light of the noble person; if there is trust, there is good fortune.
lines.image: The light of the noble person is auspicious in its radiance.

lines.text: Trust in drinking brings no blame. But if it wets its head, trust is lost in that.
lines.image: Drinking until the head is wet shows no knowledge of moderation.

core: The undertaking is not yet complete, and premature movement risks failure. Success remains possible, but only through careful discrimination, balanced action, and persistence to the end.
plain: The goal is within reach, yet the final stage is not secure. Avoid rushing or relying on partial success; distinguish the essential from the secondary and continue steadily.
advice: Finish the remaining work carefully without rushing toward an insecure conclusion.
